item.subject: science
item.stem:
Priya fries puris at home to test whether the oil is hot enough. She changes only the amount of oil she adds to the pan each time.

She wants evidence she can compare across her trials.

Which row describes what Priya should observe or measure as evidence?

options.A: observation: whether the puri puffed up; measurement: none needed; notes: written from memory after cooking
options.B: observation: whether the puri puffed up; measurement: amount of oil added each time; notes: written during the experiment
options.C: observation: none, puffing is only yes/no so it cannot be evidence; measurement: amount of oil added; notes: written during the experiment
options.D: observation: whether smoke or splatter was seen; measurement: none needed; notes: written from memory after cooking
